page.overview:
What is Force Dash?

Force Dash, or speed burst was an ability of the Force that allowed its user to increase their speed for a brief time. While powerful in short bursts, overexertion of the ability could quickly drain the Force-user of their energy for a brief period of time.

While aboard the Trade Federation starship Saak'ak, Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi used Force Dash to escape from droidekas. and later to slice through Boba Fett’s blaster carbine with his lightsaber.
